title: Sort Products by Price
description: Retrieve products from the Products table sorted by price in descending order.

data.text: Write a query to return all products from the `Products` table sorted by `Price` from highest to lowest.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: ORDER BY sorts the result set. DESC means descending (high to low); ASC (the default) means ascending. You can sort by multiple columns: ORDER BY Category, Price DESC.
